sources.title: About Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
sources.organization: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.last_updated: UNKNOWN - standing page, no visible revision date
sources.relevance: Primary description of PM-JAY objectives, SECC 2011 rural/urban eligibility criteria, benefit cover, hospital empanelment, and IT/grievance systems.
sources.reliability_note: Official National Health Authority website - Level 1 source.

sources.title: Press Release: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card enrollment milestone
sources.organization: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India
sources.publication_date: Referenced milestone data as of approx. December 2024 (enrollment reaching 25 lakh, 'less than 2 months' after 29 Oct 2024 launch)
sources.relevance: Confirms Vay Vandana coverage amount (Rs 5 lakh + Rs 5 lakh top-up), launch date (29 Oct 2024), and interaction rules with CGHS/ECHS/CAPF/private insurance/ESI.
sources.reliability_note: Official Ministry of Health and Family Welfare press release.

sources.title: Rajya Sabha Unstarred Question No. 267, answered 11.02.2025 - Ayushman Vay Vandana scheme details
sources.organization: Rajya Sabha Secretariat / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.relevance: Authoritative statement of Vay Vandana eligibility criterion (age 70+, Aadhaar-verified), mandatory e-KYC, and the one-time choice rule for holders of other government schemes.
sources.reliability_note: Official Government of India response tabled in Parliament - highest-authority primary source for this scheme's eligibility text.
sources.pdf_section: Details of the Ayushman Vay Vandana scheme (points i-v)

sources.title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Annual Report 2015-16, Chapter 11: Medical Services and Medical Supplies
sources.organization: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India
sources.relevance: Official list of persons eligible for CGHS (central govt employees/pensioners, MPs, ex-MPs, Governors, Freedom Fighters, judges, Delhi Police, Railway Board employees, etc.), list of CGHS-covered cities as of 2015-16, facilities available, and (outdated) subscription rate table.
sources.reliability_note: OUTDATED - this is a 2015-16 annual report. The core eligibility CATEGORY list has been cross-checked as stable across multiple official/near-official documents, but city list, beneficiary counts, and subscription rates in this document are NOT current and are flagged accordingly.
sources.pdf_section: 11.1.3 Eligibility for joining CGHS; 11.1.5 Subscription rates; Appendix-I (city list)

sources.title: ESI Hospitals - official statement on ESI Act wage ceiling and coverage
sources.organization: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India (via Press Information Bureau, Delhi)
sources.relevance: Confirms current ESI wage ceiling (Rs 21,000/month general, Rs 25,000/month for persons with disability), minimum establishment size (10+ employees in notified districts), and history of the last wage-ceiling revision (01.01.2017).
sources.reliability_note: Official Ministry of Labour & Employment document reproduced via PIB, hosted on labour.gov.in.

sources.title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme - myScheme listing
sources.organization: myScheme (National e-Governance Division / Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India)
sources.relevance: General eligibility framing for CMCHIS (Tamil Nadu residency, family/ration card membership, income ceiling) and benefit/procedure summary.
sources.reliability_note: myScheme is an official Government of India portal (Level 5 per this project's source hierarchy: used for scheme discovery/cross-reference). It is NOT the Tamil Nadu scheme-owning department's own primary portal, so figures sourced only from here (notably the income ceiling) are treated as needing verification against a Tamil Nadu Government Order.

sources.title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme - Tamil Nadu (differently-abled persons variant) - myScheme listing
sources.organization: myScheme (National e-Governance Division / Digital India Corporation, MeitY, Government of India)
sources.relevance: Separate myScheme listing attributing CMCHIS-style coverage to the Tamil Nadu Department for Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, with NO income ceiling for that beneficiary group. This appears to be a distinct nodal-department listing from SRC006 and creates an unresolved conflict (see conflicts.json).

sources.title: CGHS Official Portal (existence and URL only - content not independently fetched)
sources.organization: Central Government Health Scheme, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.relevance: The canonical, current official CGHS portal for applications and up-to-date eligibility/rate information. Automated fetching of this URL was blocked (robots.txt disallow) during this research pass, so its live content could NOT be directly verified or quoted. It is recorded here as the authoritative destination a developer or user MUST manually cross-check.
sources.reliability_note: URL confirmed to be the official portal via multiple independent references, but content unverifiable by automated tools in this pass. Manual verification required before production use of any CGHS rule.

sources.title: ESIC Official Portal (existence and URL only - content not independently fetched in full)
sources.organization: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.relevance: Canonical ESIC portal for employer registration, beneficiary services and current circulars. Only referenced, not deep-fetched, in this research pass; core wage/establishment facts were instead confirmed via SRC005 (Ministry of Labour PIB document).
sources.reliability_note: Manual verification recommended for operational details (documents list, portal workflow) beyond what SRC005 confirms.

sources.organization: National Health Authority (NHA), Government of India
sources.relevance: Official portal referenced by nha.gov.in (SRC001) for beneficiary eligibility check, e-KYC and card generation for both PM-JAY and the Vay Vandana expansion.
